title: Tests: HKDF vectors from RFC 5869 Appendix A
description: Write kernel test module and userspace test exercising HKDF via CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF. Use the three test vectors from RFC 5869 Appendix A (Test Cases 1, 2, 3 — SHA-256 with and without optional fields). Each vector specifies: IKM, salt, info, L (output length), and expected OKM. Hardcode as static const u8[] arrays. Test: open /dev/crypto2dev, write() IKM, call DO_KDF ioctl, export resulting KEY fd (if exportable=1) and compare against expected OKM. Tests must be fully offline — no network calls. Depends on framework (WOLFKM-6zx) and wolfssl HKDF (WOLFKM-d52) being complete.
